# Vendored fixture

`bundles/acme_retail` from GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format, fetched
from `main` on 2026-09-16. Unmodified.

It is the format authors' own example bundle, so it exercises shapes our
hand-written fixtures would never think of — Attested Computation concepts,
footnote-keyed sources, a deprecated concept kept for reproducibility. Kept
verbatim so a change in how we read OKF shows up here first.
